[[File:AlderaanianArtist-TCGEoD.jpg|thumb|right|230px|An [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] artist]]

An '''artist''' referred to someone who created art, particularly drawings or paintings.

Artists during the time surrounding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and subsequent [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]], [[Gayla Riemann]], and [[Walls]], among others.

During the Clone Wars, there was a colony of [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] artists on [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]]. They pursued art and beauty instead of the violence of the war.
